requirements.text: The Receipt add button must never cover the Recent activity list on a phone screen.
The Mileage add button must never cover the Recent activity list on a phone screen.
The "Receipt saved" confirmation must never cover the Recent activity list on a phone screen.
Every activity row in the Recent activity list must display its amount.
The Recent activity list must be scrollable past the add buttons, allowing the list to extend beyond the buttons.
The bottom tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) must be fully visible on a 390x844 phone screen.
All existing features must continue to work after the layout changes.
All existing unit and integration tests must continue to pass after the layout changes.
All existing screens must remain functional and accessible after the layout changes.
